label: Subscription activated
subject: Your {{ .PlanName }} subscription is active
heading: You're all set with
message: Your {{ .PlanName }} is ready. Let's make something worth sharing!
detail: For recording retention after your subscription ends, review the Terms of service at https://videos.recordly.dev/terms. Keep local copies of recordings you want to retain.
footer: You received this email because you subscribed to Recordly.
preheader: You're in! Your Cloud benefits are ready to use.

label: Plan changed
subject: Your Recordly plan has changed
heading: Plan updated for
message: New plan, same creative you. You've moved from {{ .PreviousPlan }} to {{ .PlanName }}. Your billing page has any charges or credits.
footer: If you didn't make this change, contact support.
preheader: Your new plan and billing details, all in one place.

label: Upcoming renewal
subject: Your Recordly subscription renews on {{ .RenewalDate }}
heading: Your next renewal with
message: A little heads-up: your {{ .PlanName }} subscription will renew automatically. You can update your payment method or cancel before renewal in your billing settings.
footer: You received this reminder about your Recordly subscription.
preheader: A quick reminder before your next renewal.

label: Cancellation scheduled
subject: Your Recordly subscription will end on {{ .EndDate }}
heading: Subscription ending with
message: We're sorry to see you go. Your {{ .PlanName }} subscription won't renew, and you can enjoy your Cloud benefits until the date below.
detail: For recording retention after your subscription ends, review the Terms of service at https://videos.recordly.dev/terms. Keep local copies of recordings you want to retain.
footer: If you didn't request this cancellation, contact support.
preheader: Your cancellation is scheduled. Here's when your benefits end.

label: Cancellation reversed
subject: Your Recordly subscription will continue
heading: Staying with
message: Glad you're sticking around! Your cancellation has been removed. Your {{ .PlanName }} subscription will continue and renew automatically.
footer: If you didn't make this change, contact support.
preheader: Your subscription will keep going. Welcome back!

label: Subscription ended
subject: Your Recordly subscription has ended
heading: Your subscription to
message: Your {{ .PlanName }} subscription has ended. Review your account for current plan details.
detail: For recording retention after your subscription ends, review the Terms of service at https://videos.recordly.dev/terms. Keep local copies of recordings you want to retain.
footer: You can review available plans in Recordly at any time.
preheader: Thanks for creating with us. Here's what's next.

label: Trial ending (if offered)
subject: Your Recordly trial ends on {{ .EndDate }}
heading: Your trial with
message: One little reminder: your {{ .PlanName }} trial ends soon. Here's what happens next, so there are no surprises.
footer: You received this reminder because you started a Recordly trial.
preheader: Your trial is nearly up. Take a peek at what happens next.

label: Payment received / renewal paid
subject: Payment received for Recordly
heading: Thanks for supporting
message: Payment received. Thanks for being part of Recordly! Your receipt for {{ .PlanName }} is ready below.
footer: Keep your receipt for your records.
preheader: All paid. Your receipt is ready whenever you need it.

label: Payment failed
subject: Please update your payment method for Recordly
heading: Payment issue with
message: Your latest payment for {{ .PlanName }} didn't go through. Let's get it sorted: review your billing details and payment method below.
detail: Your billing page shows the current payment status and any next steps. Never send card details by email.
footer: Need help with a payment? Contact support.
preheader: A payment needs a little attention. Here's where to sort it out.

label: Payment needs confirmation
subject: Confirm your payment for Recordly
heading: Confirm your payment to
message: One last step: your bank needs you to confirm your payment for {{ .PlanName }}. Finish up on the secure payment page below.
footer: Never share your bank verification code or card details by email.
preheader: Your bank needs a quick confirmation to finish this payment.

label: Card expiring
subject: Your payment card for Recordly expires soon
heading: Keep recording with
message: Your saved card expires soon. Update your payment details to help keep {{ .PlanName }} rolling.
footer: If you've already updated your card, no further action is needed.
preheader: A small card update now can help avoid a payment hiccup later.

label: Refund issued
subject: Your Recordly refund has been issued
heading: Refund from
message: Your refund has been issued to your original payment method. Your bank or payment provider handles when it appears in your account.
footer: Questions about your refund or subscription? Contact support.
preheader: Your refund is on its way back to your payment method.

label: Invoice available / payment reminder
subject: Your Recordly invoice {{ .InvoiceNumber }}
heading: Your invoice from
message: A little billing admin: your invoice for {{ .PlanName }} is ready. Open it to review the details and pay any balance due.
footer: Your invoice page shows the latest payment status.
preheader: Your invoice is ready. Everything you need is inside.

label: Credit note issued
subject: A credit note was issued for your Recordly invoice
heading: Billing update from
message: A small billing update: we've issued a credit note for your Recordly invoice. See how it was applied in your billing details.
detail: A credit note can adjust an invoice or account balance. It doesn't always mean a refund was sent to your payment method.
footer: Questions about this adjustment? Contact support.
preheader: There's a credit note for your invoice. Here's the detail.
